लड् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (लडति) To play,
sport, dally. {vII.v} {c1c} P., {c10c} P. (लडति,
लडयति)
1 To throw, toss.
--2 To
blame.
--3 To loll the tongue.
--4
To harass, annoy. {vIII.v} {c10c} U. (
लाडयति-ते)
1 To fondle, caress.
--2 To
annoy.

लाड् {c10c} U. (लाडयति-ते)
1 To
fondle, caress.
--2 To blame, censure.
--3 To throw, toss; cf. लड्.

लडह a. Beautiful, handsome (a
Prākṛta word); see लटभ.

लड्डुः, लड्डुकः A kind of sweetmeat
(a round ball of sugar, wheat or
rice-flour, ghee, and spices).
